verdicts.line: Neha, you're a superstar seller, but enterprise deals with six-month cycles are not my playground. I can't add value here. For that reason, I'm out.
verdicts.feedback: Strong founder voice. Sales motion is founder-led and slow; hire sellers before you scale marketing.

verdicts.line: Your numbers are the cleanest I've seen this week, and I mean that. But the whale risk is real and I don't know this category well enough to fight it with you. I'm out, but I'm rooting for you.
verdicts.feedback: Numbers are consistent across every answer. Defensibility against bureau and LOS players needs a sharper story than speed.
concerns: Moat is mostly data, still early

verdicts.line: Thirty-one times revenue is fantasy, and you know it. But you're a Level 2 founder: you told me what kills you before I asked. I'll make an offer, at a sane number.
verdicts.feedback: Founder-market fit is exceptional. Valuation is a market comp, not earned yet. Regulatory design is the hidden strength.

verdicts.line: 78% gross margin, no rounding, and a CA could not trip you once. The concentration scares me, but I'd rather fix that with you than watch someone else do it. I'm in.
verdicts.feedback: Economics are healthy for a seed SaaS. The 41% single-customer concentration is the number to kill in the next two quarters.
strengths: Burn and runway stated to the lakh

verdicts.line: Eleven thousand labelled credit files and source-linked memos. This is real technology built for Bharat. I want in, and I want enough of it to matter.
verdicts.feedback: The labelled fraud dataset and source-linking layer are a genuine technical moat. Productise lender onboarding fast.
concerns: Two weeks custom mapping per lender
